nodes.label: Device/Account Verification Flow
nodes.rationale: Administrative protocol ensures platform security by requiring device and credential verification against a security registry before granting access.

nodes.label: Role-Based Routing
nodes.rationale: Routes admin users to /admin and regular users to /analytics based on app_metadata.role or profiles table role lookup.

nodes.label: Multi-Sheet Master Database
nodes.rationale: Five-sheet Excel structure maps one sheet per Annex category (A through E) for division-level consolidated reporting.

nodes.label: Data Anonymization
nodes.rationale: All student identifiers are masked with V-*** and B-*** prefixes to protect victim and bully identities.

nodes.label: Audit Trail Logging
nodes.rationale: Every submission is timestamped and logged under user credentials for accountability and compliance.

nodes.label: Ormoc City Division LRP Design System
nodes.rationale: Shared Material Design 3 color tokens, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next + Inter font pairing, and Tailwind config used across all pages.
nodes.norm_label: ormoc city division lrp design system

nodes.label: Annex Category Classification Schema
nodes.rationale: Five annex categories map to specific DepEd LRP reporting domains: A=Bullying, B=Child Abuse, C=Children at Risk, D=CICL, E=Other Learner Rights.

nodes.label: Report Status Workflow
nodes.rationale: Reports flow through statuses: Draft, Submitted/Pending, Resolved, On-going Intervention, Referred to Government Agencies, or Referred to NGO.

nodes.label: Token Auth Migration Rationale
nodes.rationale: Moved from query param ?token= to Authorization: Bearer header for security. All endpoints use getToken(req) helper that reads header first, falls back to query param. sendBeacon replaced with fetch+keepalive.

nodes.label: IP Limit Design Rationale
nodes.rationale: 3 IP address limit per non-admin account enforced via registered_ips Supabase table. Admins bypass the limit. IPs persist and are cleared on approve.

nodes.label: Module-to-Annex Relabeling Rationale
nodes.rationale: Buttons renamed from Module A-E to Annex A-E to match official DepEd LRP form specifications. Annex titles use full formal names.
